item.title: Tecrys PDM 0.8.0 (build 25)
item.description:
• First public release of Tecrys PDM, the team's vault of Tecrys files.
  • Mac: the Tecrys PDM app, with the vault server (tecrys-pdm-server) and the tecrys-pdm command line inside the app.
  • Windows (x64 and ARM64): the new Tecrys PDM app, with the vault server and the command line, in one installer.
  • Updates itself: Check for Updates… (Tecrys PDM menu on the Mac, Help menu in Windows).
